c. Listen and read aloud.
equality
humanity
superstition
discrimination
Read the passage carefully and complete the following
Full name : .....
Known as : .....
Date of birth : .....
Birth place : .....
A message to society : .....
e. Add ‘-ness’ to the word and make a new word.
ness kindness For Example - kind + sad + dark + weak + fair +
f. Read and observe underlined words.
Gadge Maharaj was a saint in Maharashtra. His name was Debuji. He lived a simple life. He taught people to be kind.
Now fill in the blanks with the proper words from the box.
he
they
his
their
she
her
Meera loves books. _____ reads every night. _____ favourite book.
Rohan has a bicycle. _____ rides it every day. _____ bicycle is red.
The birds are in the nest. _____ are singing. _____ nest is on the branch.
For the Teacher :
Encourage learners to collect information of different saints from Maharashtra. Encourage them to read books about saints. Encourage them to talk about the key elements/events, ideas from this lesson.
18
